text:
nina: Monday async check — quick status on audits/vuln backlog. What landed yesterday and blockers for today?
aj: Finished the SSO IAM mapping audit for workspace-prod. Found 3 stale service accounts, created JIRAs: SEC-482, SEC-483, SEC-484.
leah: Thanks @aj. I picked up SEC-482 (remove unused SA) and will run removals in staging this afternoon.
maria: Worked on the KMS policy diffing script; pushed a draft to infra/tools repo, PR #128. Needs review for cross-account key handling.
sam: Took another pass on the dependency-scan false positives. scan-bot flagged 2 transitive libs — one is benign, the other needs upgrade. Open PR incoming.
scan-bot: weekly-sca: 2 new findings in redis-client@2.4.0 (moderate). Refer SEC-485.
achris: Quick heads-up — dedicated customers reported intermittent 503s during key rotation tests last night. I left logs in /var/log/rotations/rot-2026-03-16.log.
nina: @chris can you summarize whether it's client-side retry or server restart? We need to decide on rota timing.
chris: Looks like a short-lived node restart from the infra autoscaler coinciding with KMS key replacement. Server processed partial inflight requests. Suspect race in our rotation handler.
leah: I can add a graceful drain check before rotating keys in the rotation controller. Patch idea: check active_connections == 0 || drain_timeout_exceeded.
ina: Good. @maria can you prioritize reviewing the KMS policy PR since rotation touches ACLs?
maria: Will do today, aiming EOD. leaving inline comments on the IAM cross-account handling.
aj: On the IAM side, I need someone to pair for the policy migration to new role naming. @sam you free for 30m?
sam: Free at 11:30 PT, ping me then.
chris: I'll draft a rollback playbook for rotation failures and post to docs/security/playbooks. Need a reviewer.
ina: Assign to @aj and @maria. Also reminder: compliance wants fingerprint of last quarter's rotation logs by Wed. @chris can you export and share?
chris: Will export today and put in the secure drive (link: https://drive.redwood.internal/s/rotations/Q1-2026).
scan-bot: vuln-scan: full infra scan completed 2026-03-16 03:12 UTC. 14 total findings; 11 mitigated.
maria: Minor ask — can we add a quick flag to the policy-diff tool to output a human-readable summary for auditors? e.g., --summary-format.
aj: yes please, that would cut review time. @leah can you take that as a small follow-up?
leah: Yep, I'll add --summary-format with counts by permission changes.
sam: Blocker: blocked on the upgraded dependency because it requires a small API change in session-manager. I'll open that PR today.
nina: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- @leah: staging removals for SEC-482, and add --summary-format to policy-diff
- @maria: review KMS policy PR #128 (EOD)
- @aj: pair with @sam on role-name migration (11:30 PT) and review rotation rollback playbook
- @chris: export rotation logs for compliance; draft rollback playbook
- @sam: open PR for session-manager dep upgrade and address SCA finding
- Security team: respond to scan-bot findings (SEC-485) and update ticket statuses

If anything is urgent ping me or @leah. Otherwise we'll sync in tomorrow's standup. :thumbsup:
